US Strikes Iran Amid Tensions; Global Supply Chains Affected

The United States has launched strikes against Iran following an attack on a civilian vessel in the Strait of Hormuz. Iran's IRGC Navy has stated the strait will be closed until further notice. The conflict has also led to China temporarily banning helium exports, impacting supply chains for industries like chipmaking, and prompted discussions in Australia about biofuel mandates.
